transcript: In another five years, what will I accomplish? Will I have reached my goal? My ambition is not great But I hope to contribute quietly to the lives of others Perhaps five years from now I will have found a clearer sense of purpose Daily progress will have quietly become a single path By then I will have gathered many small achievements And I will have been seeking many things My courage will have grown through small choices I will have become a little more mature A grand prospect is not always needed I wanna be someone who can fulfill small goals My future will likely be opening quietly before me And I do believe that now

segments.text: In another five years, what will I accomplish?
